instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/tests/textStyleRanges.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. 1) yarn test:typecheck: textStyleRanges.test.tsx(29,28) and (190,30): error TS2322: Type 'ExcalidrawTextElement' is not assignable to type 'NonDeletedExcalidrawElement' (API.setSelectedElements needs NonDeleted elements; type the helper parameter / cast as other tests do). 2) yarn test:app: 'textStyleRanges > undo restores the previous ranges and redo re-applies them' fails at line 175: after Keyboard.undo() a range with the red colour is still present (expected false, received true). Senior review diagnosis: beforeEach adds the text with API.setElements, which records no history, so the range pick's IMMEDIATELY capture records the text as an added element; undo then only marks it isDeleted and getText (scene.getElement) still returns it with its range. Fix: commit the text to history before editing in this test with API.updateScene({ elements: [text], captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY }) (CaptureUpdateAction from @excalidraw/element), assert after undo that the element is not deleted and has no red range, and after redo that the range is back. Keep the other 7 tests as they are.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/textStyleRanges.test.tsx", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/textStyleRanges.test.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
